tools.name: modelica_load
tools.description: Load Modelica libraries from file system paths. Must be called before using other tools.

tools.name: modelica_parse
tools.description: Parse inline Modelica source code and return a summary of classes, components, and any syntax errors.

tools.name: modelica_flatten
tools.description: Flatten a Modelica class to its DAE (Differential Algebraic Equation) form. Resolves inheritance, modifications, and produces the flat equation system and structural BLT/index-reduction metrics.

tools.name: modelica_lint
tools.description: Lint loaded Modelica libraries and return diagnostics (errors, warnings) with source locations.

tools.name: modelica_simulate
tools.description: Flatten and simulate a Modelica model, returning time-series results. Uses the high-performance arena simulation pipeline.

tools.name: hybrid_simulate
tools.description: Flatten and simulate a hybrid SysML v2 / Modelica system.

tools.name: modelica_doe
tools.description: Run a Design of Experiments on a Modelica model. Samples the parameter space and returns input-output datasets for response surface analysis or ROM training.

tools.name: modelica_sensitivity
tools.description: Run a One-At-a-Time (OAT) sensitivity analysis on a Modelica model. Perturbs each parameter individually and reports normalized sensitivity coefficients.

tools.name: modelica_query
tools.description: Introspect a Modelica class — returns its kind, description, components, extends hierarchy, and equations.

tools.name: validate_system_consistency
tools.description: Validates cross-domain consistency across SysML v2, Modelica, and the unified OWL2 ontology (port topology, SI/QUDV units, and shared parameter bindings).

tools.name: query_ontology_sparql
tools.description: Evaluate a SPARQL-DL or Property Path query against the unified polyglot ontology.

tools.name: query_ontology_bgp
tools.description: Evaluate a multi-pattern Basic Graph Pattern (BGP) query using Leapfrog Triejoin (Worst-Case Optimal Join).

tools.name: trace_fault_propagation
tools.description: Trace connections via transitive closure of the isConnectedTo property.

tools.name: explain_inference
tools.description: Get the axiom justification chain for why a SubClassOf relationship holds.

tools.name: tgg_query_thread
tools.description: Query multi-way digital thread alignments linking SysML v2, Modelica, CAD, and Requirements.

tools.name: tgg_diagnose_conflict
tools.description: Diagnose active multi-master concurrent edit conflicts with SMT bounds and physical feasibility.

tools.name: tgg_reconcile_slot
tools.description: Reconcile a multi-master cross-domain conflict slot using a physics-constrained or authority strategy and propagate updated parameter bindings across SysML v2 and Modelica.

tools.name: rtm_query_matrix
tools.description: Query the digital thread Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) health, coverage percentages, and orphan requirements.

tools.name: rtm_suggest_links
tools.description: Suggest candidate architecture components to satisfy or verify an orphan requirement.

tools.name: rtm_diagnose_suspect
tools.description: Diagnose why a trace link was marked as suspect and suggest remediation actions.

tools.name: modelscript_closed_loop_synthesize
tools.description: Synthesize, tune, and certify a SysML v2 or Modelica model using Closed-Loop Compiler verification gates (1. Syntax, 2. QUDV Dimensions, 3. SMT Feasibility, 4. DAE Structural Balance, 5. Dynamic Simulation, STL Robustness & Parameter Tuning).

tools.name: modelscript_patch_code
tools.description: Surgically patch a model file by finding a specific searchBlock and replacing it with replaceBlock.

tools.name: modelscript_read_file
tools.description: Read file contents or a specific range of lines from a workspace file.

tools.name: modelscript_list_workspace_files
tools.description: List engineering model files in the workspace (Modelica, SysML, STEP, SCAD, CSV).

tools.name: modelica_diff_calibrate
tools.description: Calibrate Modelica model parameters against experimental or measurement curves using continuous DAE adjoint sensitivity and L-BFGS-B optimization.

tools.name: pscad_lint
tools.description: Lint a PSCAD project (.pscx, .pslx) or workspace (.pswx) file. Performs pre-flight electrical topology, parameter bounds, floating terminal, and weak grid (SCR) checks.

tools.name: pscad_simulate
tools.description: Simulate a PSCAD electromagnetic transient (EMT) circuit using the WebAssembly Dommel companion-circuit solver. Supports Bergeron lines, CDA switch damping, and OEM Inverter-Based Resource (IBR) FMUs.

tools.name: pscad_verify_ieee2800
tools.description: Automate IEEE 2800-2022 grid code compliance testing for Inverter-Based Resources (IBRs). Assesses momentary cessation, fast reactive current injection (T_90 <= 50 ms), and overvoltage ceiling (<= 1.20 pu).

tools.name: pscad_export
tools.description: Export a PSCAD project (.pscx, .pslx) to Modelica (OpenIPSL) or FMI/SSP (SystemStructure.ssd) for cross-domain digital thread interoperability.

tools.name: modelica_linearize
tools.description: Linearize a Modelica DAE model around an operating point or steady-state equilibrium to extract explicit LTI State-Space matrices (A, B, C, D), eigenvalues/poles, damping ratios, and stability margins.

tools.name: modelica_tune_pid
tools.description: Automatically tune a P, PI, or PID controller for a linearized Modelica plant model using Skogestad IMC (SIMC) and Sensitivity-Constrained Loop Shaping.

tools.name: olga_simulate
tools.description: Simulate transient multiphase flow, liquid accumulation, pressure drops, slugging, and pigging for an OLGA model (.opi, .key, .genkey).

tools.name: olga_lint
tools.description: Run pre-flight multiphase flow assurance diagnostics (M7001–M7007: CFL stability, steep risers, severe slugging dips, pig stuck hazard) on an OLGA model.

tools.name: olga_verify
tools.description: Formally verify multiphase simulation against flow assurance limits (MAOP, hydrate subcooling margin, and slug catcher capacity).

tools.name: olga_diagram
tools.description: Generate standalone SVG diagrams for an OLGA flowline: topological P&ID schematic or pipeline elevation bathymetry Z(X) with holdup heatmaps and active slugs/pigs.

tools.name: olga_parse_tpl
tools.description: Parse an OLGA simulation trend plot (.tpl) file or content into structured time-series dataset with variable catalog, units, and channel statistics.

tools.name: olga_parse_ppl
tools.description: Parse an OLGA spatial profile plot (.ppl) file or content into structured spatial snapshots along pipeline coordinate X with flow regimes and critical extrema.

tools.name: olga_tune
tools.description: Calibrate OLGA flowline model parameters (roughness, choke Cd, heat transfer, well PI) using autonomous Nelder-Mead simplex history matching against telemetry CSV observations.

tools.name: olga_gate
tools.description: Evaluate an automated Flow Assurance CI/CD Safety Gate check on an OLGA model for pull requests and operational envelope verification.

tools.name: olga_survey
tools.description: Ingest 3D seabed bathymetry survey coordinates (CSV with Easting,Northing,Depth or KP,Elevation) and discretize into adaptive curvature-aware OLGA pipe segments.

tools.name: gensys_lint
tools.description: Perform pre-flight semantic and physical validation on GENSYS railway vehicle models (.calc, .run, .sub).

tools.name: gensys_verify_en14363
tools.description: Verify derailment quotient (Y/Q <= 0.8) and Prud'homme lateral track shifting force limits according to EN 14363 / UIC 518.

tools.name: gensys_fastsim
tools.description: Compute tangential longitudinal/lateral creep forces and spin moment using Kalker's FASTSIM algorithm.

tools.name: simpack_lint
tools.description: Perform structural and reference diagnostics on SIMPACK XML (.spck) or classic deck (.sim, .mbs) files.

tools.name: simpack_mobility
tools.description: Calculate system degrees of freedom and overconstrained mechanisms using Grübler-Kutzbach spatial criterion.

tools.name: social_read_thread
tools.description: Read the conversation thread history, parent post, and attachments for a given social post ID.

tools.name: social_post_reply
tools.description: Post an engineering response or verification result to a social discussion thread on behalf of an authorized bot account.

tools.name: cad_fea_closed_loop_size
tools.description: Run closed-loop 3D CAD/OpenSCAD/STEP parametric sizing coupled with tetrahedral FEA von Mises stress analysis and BVH collision clearance verification.

tools.name: polyglot_migrate_and_verify_b2b
tools.description: Migrate legacy Simulink (.slx), SPICE (.cir), or MSC Adams (.adm) models to Modelica & SysML v2 and certify ISO 26262 Back-to-Back (B2B) trajectory & C99 equivalence.

tools.name: ssp_diagnose_cosim_stability
tools.description: Analyze an FMI 2.0/3.0 & SSP multi-FMU co-simulation topology for algebraic feedthrough loops, ZOH spectral radius instability, and synthesize stabilizing coupling schedules.

tools.name: formal_verify_safety_and_mcdc
tools.description: Prove unbounded safety invariants via IC3/PDR and Sum-of-Squares (SOS) barrier certificates, and generate DO-178C / ISO 26262 MC/DC independence-pair test vectors.

tools.name: twin_discover_sindy_and_rom
tools.description: Discover sparse nonlinear governing differential equations (SINDy) from hardware telemetry residuals and calibrate a Reduced-Order Model (ROM) digital twin.
